text:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — NovaEdge instrumentation onboarding for the joint perf/W run next week. Goal: reproducible perf and watt profiles for rtf-llama and quantized 4-bit variants. Need telemetry schema, kernel knobs, and a clear run schedule. @Jiro @Mateo can you confirm owners? :satellite:

Jiro Tanaka: I can own kernel knob list + test harness. Need remote access to the test rack. Kai, can you confirm we’ll get read-only SSH + IPMI?

Kai (NovaEdge): Yes — we’ll provision read-only IPMI and a test ssh account. We'll also ship a tiny agent that uploads 10s power samples to S3.

Mateo Cruz: Nice. For reproducibility we’ll require: 1) exact model artifacts + commit hash, 2) the workload script (tokens, seq len, batch), 3) nsys/cupti trace for at least one run, 4) aligned timestamps between token stream and power samples. I’ll draft the runbook.

Lina Zhang: I’ll own the schema and dashboard. Proposed metric names/labels: redwood.perf.tokens_per_sec, redwood.perf.tokens_per_joule, redwood.hw.power_w. Prometheus labels: model, quant, seq_len, batch, region. I’ll sketch a prometheus + telegraf mapping.

Infra-bot: perf-runner-v2 deployed to staging (perf-runner.redwood.internal) — smoke scheduled Tue 03:00 UTC.

Jiro Tanaka: Dropping the minimal run snippet I tested locally: 
```bash
# run on host
./run_perf.sh --model rtf-llama-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --tokens 10000
# collect power samples
./power_sampler.sh --interval 10 --out power.csv
```
Make sure the agent clock is NTP-synced.

Aisha Patel: Quick checklist before kickoff: - creds to NovaEdge host - runbook link + model commit - dashboard stub - marketing copy for joint announcement (if green). Kai, can you provide creds by Monday EOD? Also any constraints on publishing their board photos?

Kai (NovaEdge): Will send SSH keys and S3 role by Mon 6pm PST. Press assets: we can share logos and engineer headshots but need a 2-week review for any public announcement — so keep the announcement tentative until validation is done.

Mateo Cruz: Fine, we’ll treat the public launch as post-validation. Proposed dry-run: Wed 04:00 UTC (internal only). Lina, can you drop the dashboard stub by EOD today so we can sanity-check metrics?

Lina Zhang: Yep — stub will be up and I’ll include sample Grafana panels. :+1:

Aisha Patel: Great — I’ll calendar invite and add the doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/novaedge-instrumentation (draft). Please add blockers in the doc.

Lina Zhang: noted :+1:
